about.title: Front-End Developer Building Modern Web Experiences
about.bioP1: I am Ahmed Mahfoodh Alkasadi, a Front-End Developer with experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. I am looking to join a team where I can build modern, interactive, high-performance user interfaces.
about.bioP2: I focus on scalable, maintainable applications and value collaboration that improves user experience, supports innovation, and helps achieve customer satisfaction. My work includes React and Next.js projects built with Tailwind CSS.
about.philosophyP1: I value clean, modular code and thoughtful collaboration. My goal is to build user interfaces that are maintainable, interactive, and responsive to real product needs.
